# Projectile Spawn Pipeline — Follow-Up

**Generated by:** Task 25 of [2026-05-17-ggi-rust-integration-plan.md](2026-05-17-ggi-rust-integration-plan.md).

## Finding

Task 25 attempted to wire `homing_movement::attach_homing_state` into the
production projectile-spawn dispatch site. The plan instructed two paths:

- **Path A** — A production spawn site exists; insert a `BulletType.ranged`
  branch that calls either `attach_rocket_state` (ballistic) or
  `attach_homing_state` (homing).
- **Path B** — No production spawn site exists yet; document the gap and
  stop short of integration.

The investigation confirmed **Path B**. Greps under `src/`:

```
grep -rn "attach_rocket_state" src/
```

returns only test-module call sites:

- `src/sim/movement/rocket_movement.rs:313` — inside `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`
- `src/sim/movement/rocket_movement.rs:342` — same
- `src/sim/movement/rocket_movement.rs:370` — same

`attach_homing_state` is similarly called only from
`src/sim/movement/homing_movement.rs`'s own test module.

Greps for the obvious spawn-pipeline entry points
(`spawn_projectile`, `fire_weapon`, `spawn_bullet`, `fire_at`) return zero
hits under `src/sim/combat/`. The combat tick currently applies damage
inline at the firing instant — there is no in-flight projectile entity
pipeline to hook into.

## Implication for GGI

The homing module is fully implemented and unit-tested in isolation
(see `src/sim/movement/homing_movement.rs`). The cruise altitude
controller, sidewinder ROT modulation, stall-detect failsafe, and BAM
math helpers are all parity-checked against the Ghidra reference.
`tick_homing_movement` is wired into `World::advance_tick`, so as soon as
a HomingState attaches to any entity it will be advanced correctly.

The Guardian GI's SecondaryFire visual stance (deployed launcher) and
the MissileLauncherE elite swap are functional via the combat dispatch
work done in Batches A-C. What's missing is the bullet entity itself —
the path that turns a `combat_targeting` fire decision into a bullet
GameEntity with `homing_state` attached.

## What the spawn pipeline needs

The follow-up work should produce, roughly:

1. **A bullet entity category** — a new variant on `EntityCategory` (or
   an opt-in flag on `GameEntity`) so the combat tick can spawn a
   short-lived bullet entity that the homing module's tick advances.
2. **A spawn site** in the combat tick (likely in `src/sim/combat/mod.rs`'s
   per-attacker loop, immediately after the weapon Verses gate passes)
   that:
   - Reads `WeaponType.projectile -> ProjectileType`.
   - Resolves `BulletType.ranged` (already parsed) to pick the dispatch.
   - Creates a transient bullet entity at the firing FLH offset.
   - Calls `attach_rocket_state` or `attach_homing_state` accordingly.
3. **A despawn site** in `World::advance_tick` after the homing/rocket
   tick returns its `detonated` list — apply damage at impact and remove
   the bullet entity from `EntityStore`.
4. **Determinism review** of the new bullet entities: they show up in
   `keys_sorted()`, contribute to `state_hash`, and pass replay
   verification.

These are independent enough to be a separate brainstorm/plan rather
than additions to the GGI plan, because they affect every weapon in the
game, not just GGI's MissileLauncher.

## Status

- Homing module: complete and unit-tested (16 tests in
  `homing_movement::tests`).
- Production wire-up: deferred to this follow-up.
- GGI parity work that does NOT depend on this pipeline (sound order,
  Elite swap, OpenTransport routing, art-driven deploy duration):
  shipped in Batches A-C of the GGI plan.

When the projectile-spawn pipeline lands, the homing module is ready —
no further changes to `homing_movement.rs` should be required to wire it
in beyond the dispatch branch and despawn handling described above.
